title: Neural bases of memory development: Insights from magnetic resonance imaging
title_zh: 记忆发展神经基础：磁共振成像的洞察
abstract: In adults, a broad network of brain regions supports memory performance. Development of these brain regions, and their connections, are thought to underlie age-related improvements in this cognitive ability. In this Review, we summarize empirical research examining relations between macrostructure, microstructure and function of the developing brain and the resulting impact on memory in children and adolescents. Our synthesis suggests measures of microstructure and function (including functional connectivity) provide greater insight into developmental changes in memory compared to measures of macrostructure. Moreover, we describe both the qualitative and quantitative nature of these developmental changes, highlight the importance of individual differences and identify directions for future studies.
abstract_zh: 在成年人中，一个广泛的脑区网络支持记忆表现。人们认为这些脑区及其连接的发展是年龄相关认知能力提升的基础。本综述总结了关于发育中大脑宏观结构、微观结构与功能之间关系的实证研究，并探讨其对儿童和青少年记忆的影响。我们的综合表明，微观结构和功能（包括功能连接）测量比宏观结构测量更能深入揭示记忆发展的变化。此外，我们描述了这些发展变化的定性和定量特征，强调个体差异的重要性，并指出未来研究方向。
